title: Thread eight nuts onto a supported bracket
instruction: Fit all eight orange nuts onto the bracket studs. Each must advance at least two complete turns and reach the marked seating band. Leave the bracket on its outline and release all parts.
context: A sustained rotational-assembly prototype with measurable thread advance on a movable fixture.

scoring: Each of 8 outcome conditions earns 1/8; all conditions and numeric tolerances are listed in README.md and scene.json. Full score requires all conditions, all task bodies at <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, conservative robot clearance >=0.02 m for one continuous second. Before the hold completes, credit is capped at 0.95. Any lost part, fixture displacement, violated preservation invariant or penetration above 0.002 m permanently scores zero.
run_limit: 7200 controls at 20 Hz (360 simulated seconds), provisional budget
reset_notes: Reset the native environment, restore every body and joint to scene.json, settle, then clear scorer history. Two independent full-score trials remain required.
fidelity: Engineering draft; unvalidated rigid primitives and passive joints. Box-segment helical collision surfaces are an unvalidated coarse approximation. Clearance, handedness, friction, crest overlap and two-turn retention need native tests. The expert plan currently positions nuts; repeated wrist rotation and regrasp control are not calibrated or validated. RoboDojo Fasten Screws and existing multi-stud tasks create a high novelty risk. Eight fasteners alone is not a substantive distinction.
scores: NOT RUN: no GPU simulation, expert demonstration or Dream-1 evaluation has been executed.
